dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I don't think they'd be able to taste the food...

dialogues.speaker: Hjerson
dialogues.text: Oh? I think I see what you're getting at... There's no way a food taster would be allowed to touch something made by the Shogun themselves, as that would be seen as disrespecting the latter, correct? I guess I need to brush up on Inazuman culture.

dialogues.speaker: Hjerson
dialogues.text: I'm amazed how much you know about these things! Alright, this one's a surefire hit — "The Curious Case of the Liyue Bulle Fruit"!
